sources.applied: Render API keys are secret credentials managed in Account Settings; revoke and recreate a key believed compromised.
Render API keys do not periodically expire, so automation needs an explicit time-bounded rotation and revocation drill.
POST /services/{serviceId}/deploys accepts an exact commitId, allowing current deployment control to avoid deploy-hook reliance.
Deploy-hook URLs are secrets and Render directs regeneration when compromise is suspected.
Secrets remain outside workflow source, redaction is defense in depth, and exposed secrets must be rotated.
Verify replacement use before revoking the predecessor where continuity matters, then confirm revocation.

inference: Because Render API keys are long-lived, a protected candidate-access, retired-denial and active-access drill provides stronger continuity evidence than a calendar reminder alone.
secretHandling: No provider credential, derived fingerprint, authorization header or private deploy-hook URL is stored in source, receipts, logs or handoff artifacts.
